facts: The current stadium is approximately 47 m tall.
Latticed eaves with regional timber wrap the outer perimeter. Planting and wind circulation are integrated into the terraces.

record: Japan Concrete Institute technical account, The National Stadium
facts: Approximate plan dimensions are 325 by 250 m, with a 47 m height and a cantilever roof of up to 60 m.

record: Japan Sport Council stadium operations policy
facts: Maximum building height is 47.35 m above the established T.P. +25.09 m site datum. Five floors are above ground and two are below.

record: Japan Sports Agency stadium project coordination records
facts: Before excavation the eastern side was about 8 m higher than the west. The playing field was prepared as a level plane.

record: Japan Sport Council competition design section
facts: The published technical proposal sets the level playing field at T.P. +23.5 m. This value is used as the field estimate.
The standing stadium has an all-weather 400 m track with nine lanes and a seating palette of white, light green, gray, deep green and dark brown.
